source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (model pricing table, read directly; the page has no last-updated date). Model ids are mapped by hand from the page's display names.
unit: USD per million tokens, standard tier: no batch, data-residency or fast-mode multiplier. A model id with a -YYYYMMDD suffix takes its base id's row. "above": the rates for a whole reply whose prompt (input, cache reads and cache writes) is over prompt_tokens.
